title: Surjective comparison from dual exterior conormal to self Ext
statement: Let i:Z→Y be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], V an open of Z and n a natural number. Suppose that every z∈V has an affine neighborhood U of i(z) for which the ideal i.ker.ideal U [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] is the span of a finite Koszul-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence]. Put C=i*ker(i) using tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], B=i_*O_Z, and G=H^n(RHom_Y(B[0],B[0])) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Then there exists an O_V-linear morphism from the restriction to V of Hom_Z(exteriorSheaf(C,n),O_Z) [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power, def-pur-sheaf-hom] to (i*G)|V which is surjective on every module stalk [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. No injectivity, inverse or compatibility with Yoneda products is asserted.

proof.text: Obtain from the local Koszul comparison theorem one neighborhood of every point, the local maps and their equality on every smaller overlap open, together with section surjectivity. The neighborhoods cover the top open since the neighborhood indexed by each point contains that point.

Use existsUnique_hom_of_cover for these neighborhoods mapping to the top open. For any arrow to the pullback of two cover arrows, its composites with both projections determine a subopen of both neighborhoods, so the local compatibility hypothesis supplies exactly the gluing compatibility. Evaluate the glued morphism over the top open at each open included in top to obtain the global module-sheaf map; naturality is the glued morphism naturality. The gluing equation identifies its components on each cover member with the local maps. Represent a target germ at a point on a smaller neighborhood inside that point's chosen cover member. Section surjectivity lifts the representative, and the source germ maps to that target germ. This is the required stalk surjectivity. Empty V gives an empty covering sieve, which covers the empty top open, and a vacuous stalk claim.

lean.statement:
theorem koszulRegularImmersion_self_ext_conormal_comparison_surjection
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (V : Z.Opens) (n : ℕ)
    (hregular : ∀ z : Z, z ∈ V → ∃ U : Y.affineOpens, i z ∈ U.1 ∧
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → Γ(Y, U.1)),
        Ideal.span (Set.range f) = i.ker.ideal U ∧
          RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f) :
    let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
    let S := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0
    let H := derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf
    let G := (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (n : ℤ)).obj
        (H.obj (op (S.obj B), S.obj B))
    let T := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj G)
    let F := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj
      (Scheme.Modules.dual (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules) n))
    ∃ φ : F ⟶ T, ∀ z : V.toScheme, Function.Surjective (φ.stalkLinearMap z)
